# SSUITE

> SSUITE is a digital creative and marketing studio that makes brands visible in traditional search and AI search (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, Google AI Overviews).

SSUITE blends strategy, brand, design and technology for modern businesses. From concept to launch, the studio crafts websites, campaigns and content engineered for growth, turning attention into measurable results.

The site is German-first: German pages live at the root, English translations live under /en/. Every page declares both versions via hreflang.

## Leistungen (German — primary)

- [Branding](https://seosuite.studio/services/branding/) — Naming, Tone of Voice, visuelle Identität, Art Direction und Copywriting.
- [Web & Design](https://seosuite.studio/services/web-design/) — UI/UX, Webdesign, Full-Stack-Entwicklung, E-Commerce und Landingpages.
- [Wachstum](https://seosuite.studio/services/growth/) — SEO, KI-Sichtbarkeit, Content-Marketing, E-Mail und Organic Social.
- [Performance](https://seosuite.studio/services/performance/) — Paid Media über Google, Meta und weitere Kanäle.
- [AI Suite](https://seosuite.studio/services/ai-suite/) — KI-gestützte SEO-Plattform mit 20+ integrierten Skills, verbunden mit der Google Search Console.
- [Hosting](https://seosuite.studio/services/hosting/) — vollständig verwaltetes Hosting mit SSL, täglichen Backups, Updates und Monitoring.

## Services (English)

- [Branding](https://seosuite.studio/en/services/branding/) — naming, tone of voice, visual identity, art direction and copywriting.
- [Web & Design](https://seosuite.studio/en/services/web-design/) — UI/UX, web design, full-stack development, eCommerce and landing pages.
- [Growth](https://seosuite.studio/en/services/growth/) — SEO, AI search visibility, content marketing, email and organic social.
- [Performance](https://seosuite.studio/en/services/performance/) — paid media across Google, Meta and beyond.
- [AI Suite](https://seosuite.studio/en/services/ai-suite/) — an AI-powered SEO platform with 20+ built-in skills, connected to Google Search Console.
- [Hosting](https://seosuite.studio/en/services/hosting/) — fully managed hosting with SSL, daily backups, updates and monitoring.
